The passport the stranger left at the inn.

## The Text

**Observations.** The bearer is permitted to travel in all countries except those of the Northern League.

Entry stamped at Halvard, 2 March. Exit not recorded.

A second name, *Ilse Varga*, has been written in pencil on the inside cover and rubbed out.
